# rpc

> Cap'n Proto RPC runtime implementation, from wire framing and capability
> tables to peer orchestration and integration helpers.

## Key Concepts

- The implementation is organized by domain, not by historical Cap'n Proto
  "level" names.
- `wire/` contains stream framing and typed RPC message readers/builders.
- `caps/` contains capability table, capability pointer, and payload remap
  helpers.
- `promises/` contains promised-answer, pipelining, and return-send helpers.
- `transport/` contains the peer-facing binding contract plus concrete
  transport backends.
- `transport/tcp/` is the POSIX TCP/runtime backend.
- `transport/quic/` is the nullq-backed native QUIC backend using ALPN
  `capnp-rpc/1` and baseline bidirectional stream 0.
- `peer/mod.zig` is the public `Peer` facade; `peer/state.zig`,
  `peer/errors.zig`, and `peer/transport.zig` hold the first extracted Option 3
  boundaries, while `peer/*` continues to split behavior by domain (`call`,
  `return`, `forward`, `provide`, `third_party`, lifecycle/control).
- `integration/` provides host-facing adapters (`HostPeer`, `WorkerPool`) and is
  intentionally separate from protocol-core code.
- Source `.capnp` files live in [capnp/](capnp/); generated Zig bindings live
  in [gen/capnp/](gen/capnp/).

## Structure

- [mod.zig](mod.zig): Full RPC module exports (including integration-facing
  types and compatibility aliases).
- [mod_core.zig](mod_core.zig): Reduced core export surface for hostless targets.
- [wire/](wire/): Framing and RPC protocol readers/builders.
- [caps/](caps/): Capability tables, capability pointers, and payload remapping.
- [promises/](promises/): Promised-answer transforms and return-send helpers.
- [transport/](transport/): Transport binding, stream state, and concrete
  backend implementations.
- [transport/tcp/](transport/tcp/): TCP stream transport, framed connection, and
  listener/runtime helpers.
- [transport/quic/](transport/quic/): QUIC connection, options, baseline framer,
  outbound queue, and nullq adapter helpers.
- [peer/](peer/): Public peer facade, peer state vocabulary, transport
  callbacks, and orchestration split by domain.
- [integration/](integration/): Host-neutral peer wrapper and worker pool.
- [capnp/](capnp/): RPC schema source files.
- [gen/capnp/](gen/capnp/): Generated schema bindings used by protocol helpers.

## Key Files

- [peer/mod.zig](peer/mod.zig): Primary `Peer` API and state transitions.
- [peer/state.zig](peer/state.zig): Peer-owned limits, small state records, and
  thread-affinity helpers.
- [peer/errors.zig](peer/errors.zig): Named peer error groups for future API
  narrowing.
- [peer/transport.zig](peer/transport.zig): Peer-facing transport binding
  facade and transport callback/state helper modules.
- [peer/dispatch.zig](peer/dispatch.zig): Inbound RPC message dispatch facade.
- [peer/bootstrap.zig](peer/bootstrap.zig): Bootstrap, abort, and
  unimplemented-message control handling.
- [peer/finish.zig](peer/finish.zig): Finish cleanup and resolved-answer cleanup
  facade.
- [peer/resolve.zig](peer/resolve.zig): Resolve-message and pending-embargo
  facade.
- [peer/disembargo.zig](peer/disembargo.zig): Disembargo handling facade.
- [peer/peer_control.zig](peer/peer_control.zig): Compatibility re-exports plus
  remaining control-path handlers (`finish`, `resolve`, embargo,
  provide/accept/join).
- [peer/call/peer_call_orchestration.zig](peer/call/peer_call_orchestration.zig):
  Inbound/outbound call orchestration.
- [peer/return/peer_return_orchestration.zig](peer/return/peer_return_orchestration.zig):
  Return lifecycle and table cleanup.
- [caps/payload_remap.zig](caps/payload_remap.zig): Capability descriptor
  remapping for forwarding.
- [wire/protocol.zig](wire/protocol.zig): Typed RPC message readers/builders.
- [caps/table.zig](caps/table.zig): Import/export tracking and refcounted
  capability tables.
- [transport/tcp/connection.zig](transport/tcp/connection.zig): Framed TCP
  connection loop between transport and peer callbacks.
- [transport/quic/mod.zig](transport/quic/mod.zig): Public QUIC transport facade.
- [integration/host_peer.zig](integration/host_peer.zig): Host-facing frame pump
  adapter.
- [integration/worker_pool.zig](integration/worker_pool.zig): Shared-listener
  worker pool wiring.

## Development

- From repo root: `just test-rpc-level0`, `just test-rpc-level1`,
  `just test-rpc-level2`, `just test-rpc-level3`, or `just test-rpc`.
- The test step names remain cumulative compatibility names even though source
  files now live in domain folders.
- From this directory: `just gen-rpc` to regenerate schema bindings (requires
  `../../zig-out/bin/capnpc-zig` and `capnpc`).
- From this directory: `just check-rpc` to verify schema sync, `just sync-rpc`
  to update local schema copies from vendor.
- After peer/control edits, run at least `test-rpc-level3` because higher
  cumulative RPC steps include lower-level checks.
